items.question: Under which Cabinet Resolution was the Majra National CSR Fund in the UAE formed?
items.gold: Cabinet Resolution No. 2 of 2018 Regarding Corporate Social Responsibility.
items.fact: Majra National CSR Fund formed under Cabinet Resolution No. 2 of 2018

items.question: In the UAE, what is corporate social responsibility (CSR) defined as?
items.gold: A voluntary contribution by a company or establishment to community development through monetary and/or in-kind contributions for development projects and programmes.
items.fact: CSR is a voluntary company contribution to community development projects
